description:
SuperGravel - Dominate All Roads: This MuleKick CF RX400 Disc brake gravel road bike can do it all. Endurance design means higher headtubes for a bit more upright and comfortable riding positions.

2026 FEATURES: Advanced Carbon Frame Design with DynamicAngle Chainstay. Dynamic AngleStay, Allows shorter chainstay for more precise handling and reduces eliminates chain strikes.

Comes with wide Maxxis Gravel tires, capable of using up to 700x50c* to dominate gravel roads. Or use a narrow 700x28c for maximum speed on your commute. Laugh and float over rough roads, gravel, chipseal and revel in your powerful disc brakes through virtually all weather conditions.

Perfect for the sport to advanced level athlete wanting the pro level performance of a Carbon frame, coupled with the Gravel Specific Shimano GRX shifting precision and pro handling of a Carbon fork and dealing with a budget.
